title: iOS lock screen next/previous track controls don't work correctly
description:
## Problem
The lock screen/Control Center next/previous track buttons don't navigate the queue properly.

## Root Cause
nextTrackCommand triggered audioDidFinishPlaying instead of proper navigation.
previousTrackCommand only sought to 0, never went to previous track.

## Fix Applied
1. Added new delegate methods: audioRequestNextTrack() and audioRequestPreviousTrack()
2. Updated remote command handlers to call proper delegate methods
3. Implemented delegate methods in UnifiedAudioPlayer to call playNext()/playPrevious()

## Files Changed
- `Briefeed/Core/Services/Audio/SwiftAudioExService.swift`
- `Briefeed/Core/Services/Audio/UnifiedAudioPlayer.swift`
